brief: Find the authoritative source needed to check a claimed benefit or employment entitlement.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Verify a work-rights claim"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Verifica un derecho laboral"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Confira um direito trabalhista"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Find the authoritative source needed to check a claimed benefit or employment entitlement.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Find applicable official guidance before trusting a claim about work rights.
instruction.misconception: Assume viral claims, another country’s rules or one contract conclusively establish legal entitlement.
instruction.numeracy_support: The worked examples introduce the required operation; every assessed task retains its own amounts and assumptions.

evidence.reasoning: Claims about dollars owed need applicable official guidance. Check place and work conditions; viral posts cannot decide rights.
Work rules depend on the applicable jurisdiction and circumstances.
An applicable official source is a stronger starting point.
Official authority still has a defined scope.
A contract alone does not settle every legal conflict.
Dates and applicability determine which guidance addresses the situation.
Official routing helps match the case to the appropriate authority.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
